BiblicalUsage: Shoer is a porter, a gatekeeper of the house of God, and the lists name them by family and by post. Shallum was chief among them, they stood at the gates so that nothing unclean could enter, and their children returned from exile in their hundreds to take up the posts again. Even the porter of a besieged city had a part to play when the Syrians fled.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gate is a holy post. The porters kept the unclean out and the worshippers safe, and I hold that guarding a door for God is as much service as singing in the choir.
